description: Source code for a test runner class and associated functions used in layout test automation within the WebKit project, specifically for running, comparing, and managing test results for web rendering tests.

classes.name: SingleTestRunner
classes.description: Class responsible for executing individual layout tests, handling different test modes (sanitized, rebaseline, reftest, compare), managing baselines, and processing test results.

methods.name: run_single_test
methods.description: Function to instantiate and run a SingleTestRunner for a given test, handling device failures.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing the test runner with test parameters, drivers, and environment settings.

methods.name: _expected_driver_output
methods.description: Retrieves the expected output for a test, including text, image, checksum, and audio.

methods.name: _should_fetch_expected_checksum
methods.description: Determines if the checksum should be fetched based on options and test mode.

methods.name: _driver_input
methods.description: Prepares the input parameters for the driver to run a test, including test name, timeout, and args.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main method to execute the test based on current options (sanitized, reset, reftest, compare).

methods.name: _run_sanitized_test
methods.description: Runs a sanitized test, focusing on crashes and timeouts, ignoring actual output.

methods.name: _run_compare_test
methods.description: Runs a test and compares actual output with expected, updating baselines if needed.

methods.name: _run_rebaseline
methods.description: Runs a test and updates the baseline with current output.

methods.name: _add_missing_baselines
methods.description: Adds missing baseline files for failed expectations.

methods.name: _location_for_new_baseline
methods.description: Determines where to save new baseline data based on failure type and options.

methods.name: _overwrite_baselines
methods.description: Replaces existing baselines with current test output.

methods.name: _save_baseline_data
methods.description: Saves test output data to the specified baseline location.

methods.name: _handle_error
methods.description: Analyzes driver output for errors like crash, timeout, leak, and logs debug info.

methods.name: _compare_output
methods.description: Compares actual driver output with expected, including text, image, audio, and test harness results.

methods.name: _compare_testharness_test
methods.description: Checks if output is a testharness result and whether it passed or failed.

methods.name: _is_render_tree
methods.description: Detects if output text represents a render tree dump.

methods.name: _compare_text
methods.description: Compares expected and actual text outputs, normalizing line endings.

methods.name: _compare_audio
methods.description: Compares expected and actual audio outputs.

methods.name: _get_normalized_output_text
methods.description: Normalizes line endings in output text for comparison.

methods.name: _compare_image
methods.description: Compares expected and actual images, including diffing and hash checks.

methods.name: _run_reftest
methods.description: Runs a reftest, comparing test output against multiple reference files.

methods.name: _compare_output_with_reference
methods.description: Compares driver output with a reference, checking for mismatches or missing images.
